name: Time tracker
description: Log your hours per day against the team's projects; see the month per day and per ISO week, the total and what is left of the monthly target. Entries are private to their author (owners see everyone's). Agents read the weeks and log hours over MCP.

entry.title: Time entry
entry.description: Hours one member worked on one day.

project.title: Project
project.description: What hours are booked on; value + label make a row a Select option.

settings.title: Monthly target
settings.description: The newest row is the team's target; older rows are its history.

steps.message: A month has at most 744 hours
A project needs a code and a name

exposes.name: week_summary
exposes.title: Hours per week
exposes.description: Your logged hours in one month, grouped by ISO week (minutes, hours and days per week). month = YYYY-MM; left out = this month.

exposes.name: log_hours
exposes.title: Log hours
exposes.description: Log hours you worked on one day (as you, via the time tracker).

args.expr: m.sum > (size(s.rows) > 0 && has(s.rows[0].hours_per_month) ? s.rows[0].hours_per_month : 160) ? 'over by ' + formatDuration(m.sum - (size(s.rows) > 0 && has(s.rows[0].hours_per_month) ? s.rows[0].hours_per_month : 160), 'h:mm') : ''
p != null && p != '' ? orElse(d, '') + ' · ' + p : orElse(d, '')

components.title: This month by member
components.caption: Owners see everyone; members see themselves

components.title: Team settings
components.description: Owners only: the monthly target and the projects.

tests.name: the month's total, my rows only
hours left against the newest target
no target falls back to 160 h
computed minutes and ISO weeks group the month
a row carries its computed fields
logging lands an entry and a toast
another member cannot read my entries
ada reads only her own entry
bob cannot delete ada's entry (not found for him)
a member cannot add a project

expect.error: write 0: Only team owners can add these records
